name: Basic Passive Enumeration
description: Performs a basic, passive enumeration of a single domain without making any active requests to the target.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting the Amass passive discovery engine
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Found 120 names from 25 data sources
[1m[32m[+] example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] www.example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] blog.example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] api.example.com[0m
[1m[33m[+] mail.example.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Passive scan completed in 3.54 minutes.

name: Active Enumeration with Brute Force
description: Performs an active, more aggressive scan that includes brute-forcing subdomains to discover more hosts.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting the Amass active discovery engine
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Found 250 names from 32 data sources
[1m[32m[+] example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] www.example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] dev.example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] test.example.com[0m
[1m[33m[+] staging.example.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Active scan completed in 12.18 minutes.

name: DNS and IP Resolution
description: Enumerates a domain and resolves the discovered subdomains to their IP addresses.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting Amass discovery
[1m[32m[+] example.com	192.0.2.1[0m
[1m[32m[+] www.example.com	192.0.2.1[0m
[1m[32m[+] blog.example.com	192.0.2.2[0m
[1m[33m[+] api.example.com	203.0.113.5[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Scan completed. 150 names found, 140 IPs resolved.

name: Specific DNS Servers
description: Uses a custom list of DNS resolvers for the enumeration.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting Amass discovery using custom DNS resolvers
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Found 150 names from 28 data sources
[1m[32m[+] example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] cdn.example.com[0m
[1m[33m[+] support.example.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Scan completed in 4.10 minutes.

name: Enumeration with Verbose Output
description: Shows detailed information about each step of the enumeration process.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting Amass discovery engine
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Using DNS server 1.1.1.1
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Running VirusTotal source
[1m[32m[+] www.example.com	203.0.113.10[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Running Sublist3r source
[1m[32m[+] cdn.example.com[0m
[1m[33m[+] mail.example.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Passive scan completed in 5.25 minutes.

name: Exclude Specific Sources
description: Performs enumeration while excluding specified data sources, such as VirusTotal.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting Amass discovery engine
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Excluding sources: virustotal, crtsh
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Found 115 names from 23 data sources
[1m[32m[+] example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] blog.example.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Passive scan completed in 3.12 minutes.

name: Using a Domain List File
description: Reads a list of domains from a file and enumerates each one.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting Amass discovery from file: input/domains.txt
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Enumerating example1.com
[1m[32m[+] www.example1.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Enumerating example2.com
[1m[32m[+] test.example2.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m All domains from list have been processed.

name: Subdomain Brute-force
description: Performs a brute-force attack to discover subdomains using a wordlist.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting brute-force for example.com
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Using wordlist: input/wordlist.txt
[1m[32m[+] dev.example.com[0m
[1m[32m[+] ftp.example.com[0m
[1m[33m[+] mail.example.com[0m
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Brute-force completed in 1.5 minutes.

name: ASN and CIDR Enumeration
description: Discovers subdomains and IP addresses associated with a specific ASN (Autonomous System Number).
example_output:
